parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) The lead( II ) sulfate precipitate is separated from the rest of the reaction mixture by filtration. The impure lead( II ) sulfate remains on the filter paper. State the general term given to an insoluble substance that remains on the filter paper during filtration. ..................................................................................................................................... [1]
